# Firmware

Stock firmware versions that catalogued work starts from. A version number alone is not byte-exact identity.

| Entry | What you will find |
|---|---|
| [E-M1 Mark III firmware 1.6, build 1600](em1-iii-1600.md) | Stock update file OLY_E_139_1600_0000_0000.BIN, the input the E-M1 III mod builder downloads and checks. |

| [om5-ii firmware 1.1, build 1100](om5-ii-1100.md) | Add a full digest from a pinned manifest before byte-exact input work. |
